name: Capacitor
desc: Flux capacity %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The crew swears the capacitors hold more charge with %s close by.

name: Vent
desc: Flux dissipation %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The vents run cleaner since %s moved in, the engineers say.

name: Runner
desc: Top speed %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The pilots swear the ship runs faster with %s on the bridge.

name: Nimble
desc: Maneuverability %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The helm swears the ship turns tighter with %s aboard.

name: Plating
desc: Armor %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s checks every armor plate twice a day.

name: Bulwark
desc: Hull %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The crew knocks on the hull for luck, then on %s.

name: Ward
desc: Shield damage taken %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: Shield techs keep %s near the emitters. Nobody asks why.

name: Far sight
desc: Ballistic and energy weapon range %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s seems to notice things on the sensors before anyone else does.

name: Quick trigger
desc: Weapon rate of fire %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The gun crews race to beat %s to the loading bay.

name: Gunner
desc: Ballistic weapon damage %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s keeps the ballistic mounts company through every fight.

name: Burner
desc: Energy weapon damage %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s basks in the glow of the energy mounts.

name: Loader
desc: Missile damage and missile ammo %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s counts every missile in the racks, then counts them again.

name: Deck hand
desc: Fighter refit time %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: The deck crew works faster with %s around. It wants to see the fighters come home.

name: Steady nerves
desc: Peak performance time %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: Nobody panics with %s on the bridge.

name: Ship's nurse
desc: CR recovery and repair rate %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s visits every crew member in the medbay.

name: High spirits
desc: Maximum combat readiness %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: Morale is up. The crew credits %s.

name: Pest hunter
desc: Supplies per month %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: Not a single pest has been seen in the stores since %s came aboard.

name: Quiet
desc: Sensor profile %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: %s goes still when a scan sweeps the ship, and the crew follows suit.

name: Lucky charm
desc: Recovery chance %s per grade for its ship. D-mods are as much less likely.
flavour: Spacers touch %s for luck before a fight.

name: Pathfinder
desc: Fleet burn %s per 4 grades.
flavour: %s always seems to know the shortest way.

name: Scavenger
desc: Salvage %s per grade, as a Salvage Gantry gives.
flavour: %s will not leave a sealed panel alone.

name: Marine mascot
desc: Ground support %s per grade.
flavour: The marines take %s along on every drop.

name: Time skip
desc: Time flow %s per grade on its ship.
flavour: Clocks run fast around %s. Nobody has worked out why.

name: Small target
desc: Deployment cost %s per grade for its ship.
flavour: Command never seems to count the ship %s is on.

name: Mender
desc: Hull repairs %s a second in combat per grade.
flavour: %s fusses over every dent in the hull, and the dents go away.

name: Overcharge
desc: Ship system regen %s per grade on its ship, and one more charge per 3 grades.
flavour: %s sits by the system controls. They hum louder when it does.

name: Skeleton crew
desc: Minimum crew %s per grade on its ship. None needed from grade 10.
flavour: %s is worth ten crew, the bosun says. Nobody argues.

name: Spite
desc: Size and damage of its ship's death explosion %s per grade.
flavour: Nobody wants to be near %s when it is angry. Or near the ship.

name: Brood deck
desc: Fighter bays %s per 4 grades on its ship. Fighters in a bay it takes along go back to the cargo.
flavour: The deck crew found %s asleep in a spare launch tube. Now it is a launch tube.
